description:
Khruangbin describe the barn where The Universe Smiles Upon You was recorded
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During an interview with Jill Riley at The Current, the members of Khruangbin talk about the humble barn where they recorded their debut album, "The Universe Smiles Upon You," and its 10-year revisited version, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii."

Khruangbin's 2025 release, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii," is available on @deadoceansrecs.

Musicians
Laura Lee – bass, vocals
Mark Speer – guitar, vocals
Donald DJ Johnson – drums, keys, vocals
